producer.name: Happy Taro Brewery
producer.about: Happy Taro Brewery belongs to Kotaro Ikejima, a Kyoto University graduate who brewed sake at three breweries in Shimane and Shiga before going independent. In October 2017 he opened a fermented-food workshop in Hikone, making koji, miso and amazake.
